name: Against Fate
source:
This is a story about a girl who ended up in a juvenile colony. There, she will make new friends and learn about a clan of sorceresses which from a long time were guarding the world.

[Edited from [url=https://mrpres1dent.itch.io/against-fate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于一个女孩最终被送到少年殖民地的故事。在那里，她将结识新朋友，并了解长期以来守护世界的女术士部落。

[编辑自[url=https://mrpres1dent.itch.io/against-fate]Itch.io[/url]]
